answer: Concrete sybil resistance via ledger locking: each agent must lock a ledger entry with a nebula deposit of 15,000 POA for 18 epochs; the deposit is forfeited if the agent fails to produce valid work for 4 consecutive epochs. A harbor of 9 independent auditors verifies each epoch's work; inconsistent outputs are penalized by burning 20% of the stake. A ledger of 10 random validators checks each epoch's output; an attacker running N sybils must maintain N distinct ledgers, each with 15,000 POA locked for 18 epochs, so cost scales as N^2 while detection risk approaches 1.
